requirements.title: Security and Compliance Infrastructure
requirements.description: The system must ensure security and compliance, including encryption, audit, and compliance with relevant standards.
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a secure payment processing system, so that we can protect sensitive data.
acceptance_criteria: Annual PCI DSS Level 1 certification audit
OWASP Top 10 vulnerability scan passes with zero critical/high findings
Container images scanned with Trivy, no critical CVEs in production images

test_steps.expected_result: Scan passes with zero critical/high findings
No critical CVEs found in production images

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: The system must perform well and scale to meet the needs of users, including fast payment processing and tokenization.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want the system to process payments quickly, so that I can receive payments efficiently.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a month

test_scenarios: System availability test over an extended period
assumptions: System is properly maintained and monitored

requirements.title: Payment Processing
requirements.description: The system must process payments securely and efficiently, including payment processing flow, tokenization, and webhook delivery.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to process payments securely and efficiently, so that I can receive payments quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Payment processing flow is secure and efficient

test_steps.action: Send payment request via REST API
test_steps.expected_result: Payment processing flow is secure and efficient

requirements.title: Merchant Dashboard and Recurring Billing
requirements.description: The merchant dashboard must provide real-time visibility into transaction volume, revenue, and disputes, and allow merchants to manage recurring billing.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to view real-time transaction data and trends, so that I can monitor my business performance.
acceptance_criteria: System automatically charges customer's saved card on each billing cycle date

test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard displays with current transaction data

assumptions: Customer has a valid saved card
ambiguities: What happens if customer's card is declined during a billing cycle?

requirements.title: Refund and Subscription Management
requirements.description: The system must manage refunds and subscriptions securely, including refund processing and subscription lifecycle management.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to manage refunds and subscriptions, so that I can efficiently manage my transactions.

requirements.title: API Gateway & Authentication
requirements.description: The system must authenticate API calls securely via Bearer token and support API versioning.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to authenticate my API calls securely, so that I can ensure the integrity of my payment requests.

test_steps.action: Send API request with valid Bearer token

requirements.title: API Response Envelope
requirements.description: The system must provide a consistent API response envelope with required fields.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to receive API responses in a consistent format, so that I can parse and process them efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: API responses follow a consistent envelope

test_steps.expected_result: Response is in the expected format

test_steps.action: Verify response envelope includes required fields

requirements.title: Unique Reference ID Generation
requirements.description: The system must generate a unique reference ID for each transaction.
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a unique reference ID for each transaction, so that I can track transactions.

requirements.title: Real-Time Card Type Detection
requirements.description: The system must detect the card type in real-time as the user types.
requirements.user_story: As a customer, I want to see the card brand logo as I enter my card information, so that I can verify my card type.
acceptance_criteria: Card brand logo is displayed in real-time as the user types

test_steps.action: Enter a card number on the hosted checkout page
test_steps.expected_result: The card brand logo is displayed in real-time

assumptions: Card brand logos are correctly configured

requirements.title: Fraud Detection and Prevention
requirements.description: The system must detect and prevent fraudulent transactions.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to detect fraudulent transactions, so that I can prevent losses.
acceptance_criteria: Auto-decline of transactions scoring above 85 on the risk scale

test_steps.test_data: Velocity, geolocation, device fingerprint, transaction amount

test_steps.action: Send transaction data to fraud engine

assumptions: Fraud detection algorithms are available and documented

requirements.title: Keyboard Navigation
requirements.description: The system must allow keyboard navigation for the hosted checkout.
requirements.user_story: As a customer, I want to be able to complete my purchase using only my keyboard, so that I can shop easily.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard navigation allows full checkout completion without mouse interaction

test_steps.expected_result: Keyboard navigation allows full checkout completion without mouse interaction

requirements.title: Structured JSON Logging
requirements.description: The system must provide structured JSON logging with correlation ID.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want the system to provide structured logging, so that I can monitor and debug issues easily.
acceptance_criteria: Structured JSON logging with correlation ID

test_steps.expected_result: Logging is in JSON format and correlation ID is propagated across all services

requirements.title: Distributed Tracing
requirements.description: The system must provide distributed tracing via OpenTelemetry with Jaeger.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want the system to provide distributed tracing, so that I can monitor and debug issues easily.
acceptance_criteria: Distributed tracing via OpenTelemetry with Jaeger

test_steps.expected_result: Tracing is enabled and visualization works in Jaeger

requirements.title: Prometheus Metrics
requirements.description: The system must provide Prometheus metrics for request count, request duration, error rate, and active connections.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want the system to provide Prometheus metrics, so that I can monitor performance and issues.
acceptance_criteria: Prometheus metrics for request count, request duration, error rate, and active connections

requirements.title: PagerDuty Alerts
requirements.description: The system must provide PagerDuty alerts for error rate, latency, settlement batch failure, and fraud score anomaly.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want the system to provide alerts for critical issues, so that I can respond quickly and minimize downtime.
acceptance_criteria: PagerDuty alerts for error rate, latency, settlement batch failure, and fraud score anomaly

requirements.title: Hosted Checkout Accessibility
requirements.description: The hosted checkout must comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
requirements.user_story: As a customer, I want the hosted checkout to be accessible, so that I can complete my purchase easily.
acceptance_criteria: Hosted checkout complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA

test_steps.expected_result: Hosted checkout complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA

requirements.title: Data Retention and Archival
requirements.description: The system must retain transaction records for 7 years per PCI DSS requirements.
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want to ensure data retention and archival, so that we can comply with regulatory requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Transaction records are retained for 7 years

test_steps.expected_result: Data retention and archival are implemented correctly
test_steps.test_data: Valid data retention and archival configuration

requirements.title: Mutual TLS
requirements.description: The system must use mutual TLS with certificate rotation every 90 days.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want the system to be secure and protect data in transit, so that I can maintain customer trust.
acceptance_criteria: Mutual TLS with certificate rotation every 90 days

test_steps.action: Verify mutual TLS configuration and certificate rotation
test_steps.expected_result: Mutual TLS is enabled and certificates are rotated every 90 days

requirements.title: Secrets Management
requirements.description: The system must manage secrets via AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want the system to manage secrets securely, so that I can protect sensitive data.
acceptance_criteria: Secrets management via AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation

test_steps.action: Verify secrets management configuration and rotation
test_steps.expected_result: Secrets are managed via AWS Secrets Manager and rotated automatically

requirements.title: System Uptime SLA Requirement
requirements.description: The system must have an uptime SLA of 99.99% (max 4.38 minutes downtime per month).
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want the system to be available whenever I need it, so that I can access it without interruptions

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a month

test_scenarios: System availability test over an extended period
assumptions: System is properly maintained and monitored

requirements.title: Custom Reporting and Analytics
requirements.description: The system must provide custom reporting and analytics capabilities, including filters for date, currency, payment method, and status.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to create custom reports, so that I can analyze my business data.

test_steps.expected_result: Report builder displays the available filters

requirements.title: Error Message Handling
requirements.description: The system must handle error messages in a user-friendly manner, including localization and keyboard navigation.
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to understand and navigate through error messages easily, so that I can resolve issues quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard navigation support for error handling

test_steps.action: Trigger an error and verify the error message
test_steps.expected_result: Error message is clear and localizable

requirements.title: Bulk Actions
requirements.description: The system must support bulk actions on transactions, including refund and export.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to perform bulk actions on transactions, so that I can efficiently manage my transactions.

requirements.title: Refund Amount Validation
requirements.description: The system must validate refund amounts to ensure they do not exceed the original transaction amount.
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want to validate refund amounts, so that we can ensure valid refund amounts.
acceptance_criteria: Refund amounts sum to <= original transaction amount

requirements.title: Payment Workflows
requirements.description: The system must support various payment workflows, including standard payment processing, subscription creation, and refund processing.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to process payments securely and efficiently, so that I can receive payments from my customers.

requirements.title: Customer Checkout
requirements.description: The system must provide a secure checkout flow for customers, including payment processing and fraud checking.
requirements.user_story: As a customer, I want to complete a secure payment, so that I can purchase products online.

test_steps.action: Customer clicks 'Pay Now' on merchant site

requirements.description: The system must integrate with the cart API to accept line items, validate discount codes, and calculate shipping costs.
requirements.user_story: As a merchant, I want to integrate my cart with the payment gateway's API, so that I can manage orders and inventory efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts line items with SKU, quantity, unit price, and tax
Discount codes and promotional pricing are validated server-side
Shipping cost calculation integrates with merchant shipping provider APIs

test_steps.action: Send request to cart integration API
